title: event
description: Normalized parser output (pre-DB); seq assigned on insert.

injected.description: kind=='user' only: true if the message is a harness injection (isMeta, or a known injection envelope such as a Stop-hook/task-notification), not a human turn. Absent/false for a genuine human message and for non-user kinds. Coerced to 0/1 in the DB (see message.json).
